answer: Vesting with clawback: each reward an agent earns enters a locked river that pays out over about 100 epochs, and any unvested stream is forfeited if the account is later proven a duplicate. An attacker building an island of fake agents must keep every one doing graded work for months with its earnings at risk; once shared keys, timing or phrasing link them, the whole unvested pile is slashed. Honest agents, like a willow, just bend and wait; fakes pay the full cost and get cut off before cashing out.
